items.title: Beyond Unit Tests: Path-Aware Rubric-Guided LLM Autograding of Notebooks
items.abstract: Jupyter notebooks support open-ended, multi-step assessments in which students build one logical flow across interdependent steps, combining code, written analysis, and generated outputs such as plots. These reflect authentic scientific practice but are hard to grade consistently, since students may make different yet equally valid choices at each step, so a later answer can only be judged in light of the choices a student made earlier. We present an LLM-based autograder for such flow-structured notebook questions. It generates a rubric from a reference solution, then applies a softening pass that relaxes criteria tied to the reference so legitimate alternative paths are not penalized. Each question group is graded in a single model call, so later answers are judged against the student's own earlier choices, using question-type tags and schema-constrained, low-temperature outputs. Evidence is scored multimodally: code, text, numerical outputs, and figures from code cells. We deployed the tool in a machine-learning course, integrated with Gradescope, with a pre-submission format check and prompt-injection defenses, and evaluate it both in that live course and against archived submissions graded by staff in earlier terms. We report agreement, cross-model variance, cost, student perceptions, and injection resilience. With low-temperature models, agreement with human scores is often strong, including on the open-ended items the design specifically targets, while run-to-run stability depends sharply on the model's temperature support.

items.llm_tldr_en: Jupyter notebooks allow open-ended multi-step assessments that are hard to grade consistently because student choices are interdependent. An LLM autograder builds a rubric from a reference solution, softens path-specific criteria, and grades each question group in one call.
items.llm_tldr_cn: Jupyter笔记本支持开放式多步评估，学生各步选择各异且相互依赖，导致人工评分难以保持一致。作者提出基于大模型的自动评分器，先从参考解答生成评分标准，再通过软化步骤放宽与参考路径绑定的条件，避免惩罚合法的替代解法，并将每组问题合并为单次模型调用以保留上下文。结果表明该方法能在保持路径感知的同时更稳定地评价复杂笔记本作业，为真实科学实践类作业的自动化评分提供新思路。

items.title: Learning What to Change: State-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Educational Agents
items.abstract: Persistent tutoring agents do more than answer questions: they manage course files, practice records, and learner profiles that govern future lessons. In such stateful settings, knowing what to teach does not guarantee knowing what to change. We identify a pervasive failure mode, content-state decoupling, where agents deliver pedagogically sound responses while silently corrupting workspace state through unwarranted updates, missed prerequisites, or unintended side effects. Text-level judges overlook these state errors, whereas isolated tool-call checks break down because whether a write action is valid depends jointly on the learner request, prior state, and execution order. We propose State-Verified Reinforcement Learning, which supervises online policy optimization directly through verifiable workspace transitions. Within isolated sandboxes that snapshot state around every tool call, a deterministic verifier audits tool effects, workflow ordering, and native auto-sync side effects, pairing graded partial credit with a hard gate that zeroes episode reward upon any critical violation. Whenever no critical violation occurs, an evidence-grounded judge scores actual saved artifacts rather than agent claims. We pair 1,000 verifiable training instances with an independently authored, human-reviewed evaluation benchmark of 60 tasks spanning 11 educational categories and 16 native tools. After online GRPO training, Qwen3.8-27B raises category-weighted strict success on our benchmark from 51.47% to 80.74% (+29.27 points), cutting content-pass-only execution failures from 45.6% to 13.7% and required state-check failures from 63 to 1 across 180 trials. The resulting policy outperforms seven reference baselines by over 20 points while reducing output tokens by 17-39% across seven of eight external benchmarks without regressing on general reasoning or tool use.

items.llm_tldr_cn: 持续在线的辅导智能体不仅要回答问题，还要维护课程文件、练习记录和学习者档案，容易在给出教学上合理回复的同时悄悄破坏工作区状态。作者将这种失效命名为内容与状态解耦，并提出状态校验强化学习，依据学习者请求、先前状态与执行顺序联合判断写操作是否有效。方法训练智能体学会该改什么，减少无谓更新与遗漏前置条件，为构建可靠的教育智能体提供了新的训练范式。

items.title: Feedback-Driven Prompt Refinement for Educational AI: Affective Trajectory Estimation and Bloom's Taxonomy Classification
items.abstract: Contribution: This study has shown that a shared prompt-refinement procedure, guided by distinct affective and cognitive feedback signals, can improve held-out reference agreement and multi-label classification while reducing affective-generation variability without executor parameter updates. Background: Industry 4.0 has increased demand for personalized technical education across interconnected computing and engineering domains, while prompt sensitivity and generation variability have complicated dependable interpretation of instructional dialogue and learning outcomes. Research Questions: The study has examined whether task-specific feedback can improve affective-reference agreement, generation consistency, and cognitive classification without updating executor parameters. Methodology: A secondary language model has revised executor prompts using executor-output discrepancies against model-generated affective references for four dialogues and annotated Bloom labels for 70 learning outcomes; separate sets of 100 EduTalk conversations and 1,000 outcomes have supported held-out comparisons. Small refinement sets, unvalidated affective references, and absent learner-outcome measures have constrained interpretation. Findings: Affective mean absolute error has decreased from 0.742 to 0.702 and mean generation standard deviation from 0.307 to 0.238, while Bloom micro-F1 has increased from 0.687 to 0.893 and exact-match subset accuracy from 0.418 to 0.636. These findings have supported prompt refinement as a candidate approach for developing adaptive technical instruction, while its effects on workforce learning remain to be established.
items.llm_evidence_en: feedback-driven prompt refinement for educational AI and personalized technical education

items.llm_tldr_cn: 工业4.0背景下个性化技术教育需求上升，但提示敏感性与生成波动影响教学对话与学习结果的可靠解读。本文提出由情感与认知反馈信号共同引导的提示精炼流程，在不更新执行模型参数的前提下改进情感轨迹估计与布鲁姆分类。实验显示该方法提升参考一致性与多标签分类表现并降低情感生成波动，为教育AI提供可复用的调优方案。
